listings.description: Welcome to this 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom home perfect for first-time buyers or anyone seeking a cozy, well-located property. Nestled in a quiet neighbourhood close to schools, parks and shopping, this home offers both convenience and comfort. The spacious deck is ideal for hosting family gatherings, summer BBQs, or simply enjoying morning coffee in the fresh air. The finished basement adds valuable living space, featuring a bedroom, half bathroom and a dedicated office ideal for remote work or quiet study. Note: the basement bedroom window may not meet current egress standards. Shingles replaced 2026.
